silhouette.reason: Reads as a dense brick block: water tanks, bulkheads, fire escapes, cornices and street trees now break the roofline.
fixes: deeper projecting cornices (0.4–0.6 m) and parapets of varied height on each building

proportions.reason: Storey heights vary between buildings now, but many roofs are the same flat slab height in FRONT/SIDE and the trees are small lollipops for a city street.
fixes: taller street trees (8–12 m) with irregular crowns; vary roof heights within each row

materials.reason: Brick tones vary per building and windows read as a grid; the street is now dark-grey asphalt instead of black and the roofs vary between dark grey, light grey and buff membranes. The street has no lane markings, each roof is still one flat colour, and the sidewalk is a striped grey.
fixes: lane markings and kerb lines on the asphalt; sidewalk slabs instead of stripes
patches, gravel and vents on each roof membrane

detail.reason: Fire escapes, water tanks and some storefront bands exist; at hero distance windows have no sills/lintels and the ground floors are mostly blank.
fixes: storefronts with awnings and doors on every street-facing ground floor
window sills and lintels as shallow boxes at LOD0

wear.reason: Roofs now vary in tone, but nothing is weathered: no grime gradient at street level, no soot streaks under cornices, no patched roofs.
fixes: grime gradient at street level and soot streaks below cornices
patched roof membranes in varied greys

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 keeps the massing and many window grids, but a few front facades go blank brown.
fixes: bake the window grid into LOD2 vertex colour on every facade

technical.reason: QA clean; 60k / 29k / 6k triangles, 1 draw. LOD1 at 29k is half of LOD0 for a block seen from distance.
fixes: make LOD1 drop window frames/insets and fire escapes (ctx.lod gate) so it sits near 10k
